visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair and white-rimmed glasses wearing a black t-shirt holds a large square box with a vibrant rainbow holographic finish. He smiles broadly at the camera, looking directly into the lens. The background is a plain, brightly lit indoor wall. (2) Close-up of the box being tilted under light, showcasing the shifting colors across its corrugated surface. The logo 'Double U' is printed in white at the center. The man's hands are visible holding the sides, showing a ring and a watch on his wrist. (3) The camera angles down to show the open box on a table with a green and white patterned cloth. The man picks up a card with a sketch and the text 'To RAY'. He points to a black t-shirt inside the box, which has a colorful graphic of a digital toy. (4) Detailed shots of the t-shirt graphic which depicts a pink 'Tamagotchi' style device. As the man moves the fabric, the central screen of the graphic changes from a ghost figure to a grave, demonstrating a lenticular printing effect. He points at the graphic repeatedly. (5) The man fans out a deck of playing cards. These cards are unique, featuring illustrations of various sneakers like the 'Jack Purcell' and 'Wade Signature' models. He holds them close to the lens to show the text and images clearly. (6) He reveals a set of transparent playing cards with central character graphics. He fans them over his face to show their see-through nature. He also presents a white silicone oval pouch with a logo and a bright green, semi-translucent plastic character accessory.
